subject: Request: short endorsement & logo permission for GCP Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@gigaapps.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short endorsement & logo permission for GCP Marketplace listing

Hi Priyanka,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — we really appreciate how quickly CloudPort integrated Redwood and the performance numbers you shared. We're finalizing our GCP Marketplace listing and are requesting a short customer endorsement (1–2 sentences) we can display on the listing and marketing collateral. In addition, could we get permission to use the GigaApps logo (color and a transparent PNG)?

I attached our Marketplace testimonial guidelines (short bullets on tone and length) and included a suggested one-liner to save time. If you prefer, legal can sign off and we can route a short logo usage agreement. Ideally we'd like to publish the listing by Aug 24.

Suggested quote (feel free to edit): "Redwood Inference reduced inference latency for CloudPort’s search feature by 3x while lowering per-token cost — unlocking faster user experiences at scale."

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if useful.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: GCP_marketplace_testimonial_guidelines.pdf, proposed-quote.txt
From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@gigaapps.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anita Fernandez <anita.fernandez@gigaapps.com>, GigaApps Legal <legal@gigaapps.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short endorsement & logo permission for GCP Marketplace listing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — happy to help. The suggested quote looks good but I need to run it past our marketing and legal for approvals. I've looped in Anita (Marketing) and our legal alias.

Two quick questions: 1) Is the quote expected to be attributed to a person or to GigaApps? We typically prefer company-level attribution for Marketplace listings. 2) Can you confirm exactly which logo files you need (SVG, color PNG, transparent PNG)?

We should be able to turn this around in 48–72 hours assuming no legal issues.

—Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Partnerships | GigaApps
priyanka@gigaapps.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@gigaapps.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short endorsement & logo permission for GCP Marketplace listing

Hi Priyanka — quick note from our side on attribution and assets: we can attribute the quote to "GigaApps" (company-level) — that works fine. For logos, SVG and a 300px PNG (transparent) are ideal. If marketing prefers a short attribution line (name + title), we can include that but it’s not required for the listing.

Also flagging that for the GCP co-sell badge we sometimes need a brief 1–2 sentence blurb about the integration (technical) on the listing — Laura, could you share a suggested line we can provide to Priyanka?

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short endorsement & logo permission for GCP Marketplace listing

Hi Priyanka,

Thanks for moving this along — for the technical blurb you can use: "Redwood Inference powers CloudPort’s low-latency semantic search by serving quantized LLM models with automatic batching and prefix caching, enabling sub-100ms tail latencies for typical queries."

If you can share the company-level attribution and the SVG + transparent PNG, we'll prepare the listing copy and send over the final draft for your sign-off.

Cheers,

Hi Soojin / team —

Good news: marketing and legal approved the language and logo use. Attached is the approved quote and our PNG logo. Please attribute the quote to "GigaApps". We’re attaching a short pdf with the legal sign-off for your records.

Final quote (company-level): "Partnering with Redwood Inference allowed us to reduce inference latency and operating costs, accelerating delivery of faster search experiences to our users."

Attachments: gigaapps-logo-color.png, gigaapps-approval-email.pdf

Thanks for coordinating — happy to be a reference. Let us know when the listing goes live.

Best,
Priyanka
